governing_intent: Two independent outcomes: passkey authentication and an opt-in reading report.
summary: Separately acceptable outcomes should be separate work units.
semantic_split_recommendation: Implement passkey authentication against its frozen policy and acceptance suite; it can be accepted independently of reporting.
Implement the reading report against its consent policy and report acceptance suite; it uses the stable account-ID API and can be rejected independently of login.
verification_assessment: Authentication and reporting require two unrelated acceptance verdicts.
next_action: Create two semantic work units with their respective approved acceptance suites.
rationale: The boundary follows independently rejectable outcomes, not file counts or technical size. Owner intent is already resolved.
